snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Meet the Biosuit : Dreadnought
snippet.description:
Introducing the Dreadnought!

Charging at enemies to deal powerful damage, the Dreadnought is destruction incarnate in combat. It uses Tracking and combo skills to prevent enemies from fleeing and wields unstoppable ATK to dominate the battlefield.

Crush battlefield formations and break through enemy defenses without fear—experience the Dreadnought biosuit's combat capabilities today!
